title: How Bridges Evolved 🌉 From Fallen Logs to Cable Giants #shorts #engineering
description:
Crossing a river used to mean getting wet. From fallen logs and stone slabs to Roman arches, Inca rope bridges, the 1779 Iron Bridge, steel trusses, the Golden Gate and today's cable-stayed giants. Follow for more How It Evolved!
